lessons: A voltage drop to near zero signals a short, but it is not by itself evidence that a visible filament has bridged the gap or later retracted — the imaging and the electrical record need separate checks.

events.detail: Voltage log over 46.9 h (84433 samples, one every 2 s; voltage series m_eaf15b6fd611 and clock m_bf92bd7d5647 keep one per minute). Protocol: cycle 1 charge at 2 mA/cm2: 0.00-13.90 h; cycle 1 relax after charge at 0 mA/cm2: 13.90-16.90 h; cycle 1 discharge at 2 mA/cm2: 16.90-26.20 h; cycle 1 relax after discharge at 0 mA/cm2: 26.20-29.20 h; cycle 2 charge at 4 mA/cm2: 29.20-36.18 h; cycle 2 relax

data.summary: Voltage log over 46.9 h (84433 samples, one every 2 s; voltage series m_eaf15b6fd611 and clock m_bf92bd7d5647 keep one per minute). Protocol: cycle 1 charge at 2 mA/cm2: 0.00-13.90 h; cycle 1 relax after charge at 0 mA/cm2: 13.90-16.90 h; cycle 1 discharge at 2 mA/cm2: 16.90-26.20 h; cycle 1 relax after discharge at 0 mA/cm2: 26.20-29.20 h; cycle 2 charge at 4 mA/cm2: 29.20-36.18 h; cycle 2 relax after charge at 0 mA/cm2: 36.18-39.18 h; cycle 2 discharge at 4 mA/cm2: 39.18-43.91 h; cycle 2 relax after discharge at 0 mA/cm2: 43.91-46.91 h. Plating markers (time into each charge): cycle 1 charge (2 mA/cm2): voltage first goes below 0 V vs Li/Li+ after 7.43 h +/-0.68 h assuming voltage error within +/-10 mV (accuracy not stated; -0.0 mV logged) — m_15c60672412e; cycle 1 charge (2 mA/cm2): voltage first comes within 5 mV of the final-hour median (-0.04681 V) and stays in that band for at least 30 min (an operational plateau definition) after 10.21 h +/-10.21 h assuming voltage error within +/-10 mV (accuracy not stated; -41.8 mV logged) — m_4148e71ef3f3; cycle 1 charge (2 mA/cm2): voltage reaches its lowest value in this charge after 11.44 h +/-2.46 h assuming voltage error within +/-10 mV (accuracy not stated; -51.8 mV logged) — m_60f763c089b6; cycle 2 charge (4 mA/cm2): voltage first goes below 0 V vs Li/Li+ after 0.22 h +/-0.03 h assuming voltage error within +/-10 mV (accuracy not stated; -0.0 mV logged) — m_e9430ee33e96; cycle 2 charge (4 mA/cm2): voltage first comes within 5 mV of the final-hour median (-0.04634 V) and stays in that band for at least 30 min (an operational plateau definition) after 4.87 h +/-4.87 h assuming voltage error within +/-10 mV (accuracy not stated; -51.3 mV logged) — m_bc51cf0e7589; cycle 2 charge (4 mA/cm2): voltage reaches its lowest value in this charge after 0.81 h +/-0.42 h assuming voltage error within +/-10 mV (accuracy not stated; -102.9 mV logged) — m_2288410c8688. The stated 10 h onset can't be reconciled under the assumptions that onset = first 0 V crossing and voltage error is within +/-10 mV: its time window still lies before 9.5 h. The logged 5 mV plateau is an operational definition, with no precise physical onset established at this voltage accuracy. Cycle 2 is in the log, not in this movie. The full source log is retained for computation; the returned series keeps one sample per minute.

args.text: When judging lithium plating onset from voltage, state whether onset means first crossing below 0 V or settling to a plateau and what voltage accuracy is assumed, because the two definitions give different times.

events.title: When judging lithium plating onset from voltage, state whether onset means first crossing
Remembering a lesson
events.detail: Lesson saved (lesson_8f2d677bcd).

data.answer: Lithium plating onset by first voltage drop below 0 V was measured at about 7.4 hours into the first charge [claim_f9a2b6d485] (~6.8–8.1 h). Under the assumption that onset equals the first 0 V crossing and voltage error is within ±10 mV, this does not agree with a stated onset after 10 h (window still before 9.5 h); the operational plateau near 10 h has ±10 h uncertainty and no precise physical onset at this accuracy.
data.not_proven: Imaging confirmation of the first visible lithium deposit time and its growth speed could not be proven because the movie clock is too coarse (±1224 s). Direct visual onset time not established.

lessons.text: A voltage drop to near zero signals a short, but it is not by itself evidence that a visible filament has bridged the gap or later retracted — the imaging and the electrical record need separate checks.

When judging lithium plating onset from voltage, state whether onset means first crossing below 0 V or settling to a plateau and what voltage accuracy is assumed, because the two definitions give different times.
